audit.why: 45.85% over 554 games is the worst number in this slice, and the chart matches it: Shen owns levels 2-3 and everything from first item on, with only the 6 window and the flat stages going Camille's way. EVEN/6-of-10 is generous but defensible given the level-6 swing; the shape of the lane is stated correctly.

Camille's spikes (level 2-3 Precision Protocol recast into a Spirit's Refuge cooldown, level 6 Hextech Ultimatum, first-item Tactical Sweep max-HP shred) and Shen's (levels 4-6 with Spirit's Refuge plus Shadow Dash, then tank items) are correct. Nothing invented.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shen's Q is called 'Vorpal Blade' in three places (spikes[3].text, mid, wants.foe[1]). Vorpal Blade is a retired name. Shen's passive is referred to only as 'his passive shield'. Camille's R is written without its article.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon names Shen's Q Twilight Assault and his passive Ki Barrier. The decisive interaction is already half-stated but never quantified: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks, and Precision Protocol delivers its damage as two empowered attacks, so his W blanks Camille's main damage. Spirit's Refuge is 16s at rank 1 falling to 10s, and Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 falling to 10s — those two numbers are the whole trading pattern, and neither appears anywhere.
audit.corrected: Twilight Assault and Ki Barrier named; Spirit's Refuge 16s and Shadow Dash 18s written into the trade advice; R given its full name.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text says to commit 'when his W is on cooldown' and 'never E in while his taunt is up' without giving either duration.
audit.why: Shadow Dash at 18s is longer than Hookshot at 16s early, so baiting the taunt genuinely buys a window; Spirit's Refuge at 16s does not. Numbers turn both lines from a slogan into a plan.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns added to spikes[0].text and mid.

audit.why: The Stand United point is the strongest thing in this matchup and it is already made: every global he casts abandons the lane, so his map strength is Camille's local free farm. Stand United is a 200s cooldown at rank 1, which is worth stating and is now in the text.

edits.before: Hextech Ultimatum drags Shen into an arena he can't leave — and the second he R's (Stand United) to save bot, you E in off the wall and crash the wave or take plates uncontested.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum drags Shen into an arena he can't leave — and the second Stand United goes out on its 200s cooldown, you E in off the wall and crash the wave or take plates free.

edits.before: Shen's window: he drops W over himself to negate your empowered Q hits, soaks the trade, then E-taunts you (Shadow Dash) mid-combo and swings his Q (Vorpal Blade) into you while you're locked.
edits.after: Shen's window: Spirit's Refuge over himself blanks your empowered Q attacks, he soaks the trade, then Shadow Dash taunts you mid-combo and Twilight Assault swings into you while you're locked.

edits.before: Your lethality/bruiser spike plus W (Tactical Sweep) — outer-edge max-HP damage and sustain off him — lets you chunk his stacked HP faster than his passive shield refreshes.
edits.after: Your lethality/bruiser spike plus Tactical Sweep — outer-edge max-HP damage and sustain off him — chunks his stacked HP faster than Ki Barrier can refresh between his casts.

edits.before: Hextech Ultimatum locks him in with no escape, and every Stand United he casts hands you a free E-in to take the side — this stage is yours.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum locks him in, and every 200s Stand United he casts hands you a free E-in to take the side — this stage is yours.

edits.before: He out-trades you: W eats your Q hits, then Shadow Dash taunt into Vorpal Blade while you're locked, and he sustains as a tank.
edits.after: He out-trades you: Spirit's Refuge eats your Q attacks, then an 18s Shadow Dash taunt into Twilight Assault while you're locked.

edits.before: From 4-6 he gets dangerous: he point-blanks W over himself, soaks your empowered Q hits, then E-taunts you mid-combo and swings Vorpal Blade into you while you're locked — that's how a tank trades even into you. Bait the Shadow Dash before you commit your own E dash; never E in while his taunt is up. At 6 you flip it — Hextech Ultimatum locks him in an arena with no exit, and crucially, every time he Stand United's to a teammate he abandons the lane, so you E in and take the side. That global is his strength map-wide but your free farm/plates locally.
edits.after: From 4-6 he gets dangerous: Spirit's Refuge point-blank blanks your empowered Q attacks for 16s of downtime, he soaks the trade, then Shadow Dash taunts you mid-combo and Twilight Assault lands while you're locked. Shadow Dash is 18s to your 16s Hookshot, so make him spend it before you dash. At 6 you flip it — The Hextech Ultimatum locks him in an arena with no exit, and every 200s Stand United he casts abandons the lane, so you E in and take the side. His global is map strength, your local free farm.

edits.before: Hold Shadow Dash to interrupt your E dive or your R cast, then Vorpal Blade and energy-auto you while you're taunted
edits.after: Hold the 18s Shadow Dash for your E dive, then land Twilight Assault and energy-auto you while you're taunted

edits.before: Cleanest window: land Q's first hit, wait the ~1s, and recast for the bonus-true-damage second strike during the long cooldown of his W (Spirit's Refuge), which can't shelter every hit.
edits.after: Cleanest window: land Precision Protocol's first hit, wait the ~1s, and recast for the true-damage second strike inside the 16s Spirit's Refuge downtime, when nothing blanks your attacks.

notes: 'Vorpal Blade' was a genuine fabrication here — it is a retired Shen ability name and appeared three times; Riot's current name is Twilight Assault. The packet's suspectNames flagged 'Stand United's' and 'Hextech Ultimatum', which were only near-misses. I left wants.foe[1]'s original claim that Shadow Dash interrupts Camille's R cast out of the rewrite: The Hextech Ultimatum is described by Riot as a dash, not a channel, and I cannot verify from the kits whether a taunt landing mid-dash cancels it.
